olivia: Quick heads-up — just rolled a TTL-aware hybrid-evict policy to a small kv-cache canary (10 hosts). Early signals are promising: p50 token cost ~ -18%, p99 tail latency ~ -12% on the small-prod model slice. Main idea: prefer TTL-based soft-evict for short-lived prefixes and use hybrid LRU/weight-based eviction for long-lived heavy prefixes. :tada:

Dario: love it. can you paste the raw numbers and which models were in the canary?

olivia: sure — canary included: small-chat-v2, seq-lite, and a handful of high-prefix-dup web workloads. Raw: small-chat-v2 p50 cost -19.2%, p99 latency -11.4%. seq-lite p50 cost -15.6%, p99 -9.1%. aggregate token cost -18%. Will attach graphs next.

maya: linked the grafana panel: https://grafana.internal/r/kv-evict/2213 — look at the "cost-per-token" and "p99-latency" grouped by model. green = baseline, blue = canary.

infra-bot: deploy:kv-cache-canary started by olivia at 2213456790. canary hosts: 10, platform: dedicated-gpu-pool-3.

sam: what's the config diff? quick snippet?

olivia: config diff (high level):
```
kvcache.evict_policy = "hybrid_ttl_v2"
kvcache.ttl_soft_threshold_ms = 600_000
kvcache.weight_decay_window = 5m
kvcache.fallback_policy = "legacy_lru"
```
we also added a short grace period so new prefixes < 30s are pinned to avoid premature eviction.

dario: any regressions observed (errors, memory spikes)?

olivia: no error spike. mem usage on canary hosts +2% peak due to grace pins but steady. CPU slightly up (~3%) on cache management threads. tradeoff looks worth it for the cost & latency wins.

nate: updated the runtime console dashboard and cost charts under "kv-cache / eviction". also added a per-tenant breakdown so we can spot edge tenant regressions.

maya: ran quick AB on regen perf — slightly better consistency on multi-turn queries. noted reduced variance for long prefix sessions.

sam: rollout plan? risk window?

olivia: promoting to 40% in 30m, 75% in 2h, full in 8h if no red flags. rollback flag: `kvcache.evict_policy=legacy` via feature-flag service. canary monitor alerts: p99-latency > baseline + 5% OR error-rate +0.5% will auto-pause rollout.

dario: sweet. any docs for how to tune TTL thresholds per workload?

olivia: adding a short doc to eng-runtime/wiki with tuning knobs and a perf playbook. quick notes: shorter TTLs help bursty web workloads, longer TTLs for conversational sessions. will post when done.

infra-bot: canary completed at 2213456801 — no alerts triggered.

olivia: final summary: net win across canary slice, cost -18% P50, p99 latency -12% aggregate. Promoting per plan. huge thanks to infra + runtime folks for the config and dashboards. cc @dario @maya @sam :rocket:

nate: leaving a follow-up task to collect 24h post-rollout metrics and sanity-check eviction hit patterns.

olivia: noted — will ping when 24h data is in.

sam: :thumbsup:
